# Truncated SHA-256 digests of the issued premium unlock codes, one per
# line, lowercase hex, sorted ascending so the app can binary-search them.
# The codes themselves are not derivable from these and are not in this
# repository. Text rather than a blob because F-Droid's scanner rejects
# binaries in source, and rightly so: this way it is reviewable.
